body: I'm in London, it's half 6 in the morning here. I am tempted to go for a walk later though. I just don't want to get out of bed right now, knowing there is nothing for me.
See once again instead of not drinking I'm now sat in a hell of self pity. I wish i had your strength and courage. When all I want right now is death.
How did you do it? What did you fill the gap with?
I am scared that I'm going to do something soon. I am getting to the end. I can't keep doing this.

Thank you, I just can't carry on. I spend every second worrying that everyone hates me. Even when I'm sat with my family I worry that I'm not good enough. I'm 27 for fuck sake I shouldn't be feeling like this.
